name: Changzhou Kaidi Electrical Inc.
summary: Changzhou Kaidi Electrical Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, production, marketing, and sale of linear drive systems in China and internationally. It offers products, including electric push rods, manual controllers, electrical boxes, and other supporting components. The company also provides functional sofa products, such as control box, iron frame, putter frame, hand controller, lithium battery pack, and switching power supply frames; intelligent lifting table products comprising table push and stand, frame, and footboard; electric home and medical care beds; and photovoltaic push rods.
